verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a distributed mode with horizontal scaling, where GPU worker nodes self-register with a frontend coordinator. This roughly corresponds to spreading load across GPUs, i.e. data-parallel style serving. Nothing in the evidence describes splitting a single model across multiple GPUs. Missing for 10: tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, multi-GPU splitting within one node, configuration docs for parallelism strategies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
